occupancy.description: Notes holding key slots: alive plus soft-evicted.

pinned.description: Alive notes exempt from capacity reclaim.

kv_scope.description: The scope the key-value store reported for the last write: temp, persistent, or unknown before any write. temp means the memory is wiped at the next activation.

host_created.description: Notes the migration walk carried into the host record as new memories.

host_reinforced.description: Notes the walk found already present in the host record (similarity at or above the reinforce threshold) and reinforced instead of duplicating.

host_updated.description: Near-duplicates the walk consolidated into the existing host memory via supersession.

host_skipped.description: Notes the walk left in plugin KV only: soft-evicted before migration, or the host refused the remember.

projects.description: Alive notes per project, count descending then name.
